beats.en: Get clear! A horse has bolted!

as.shi: 相公快閃開，馬衝過來了！

asEn.guan: Quick, sir, get out of the way! That horse has bolted!
asEn.shi: Out of the way, sir, the horse is charging!
asEn.fu: Madam, get behind the trees, quick!
asEn.tong: Child, come over here to me, quick!
asEn.seng: Get clear, Master! A bolting horse!
asEn.jun: Soldier, help us stop that horse!
asEn.li: Brother, lend a hand to stop the horse!

beats.en: Grandpa, that horse is so fast!
Don't play by the road. Get indoors.
Stop! Head that horse off!

beats.text: 衝進集市，可要出人命的。
beats.en: If it gets into the market, someone will be killed.

beats.text: 你瞧，馬夫還在後頭追哩。
beats.en: Look, the grooms are still running after it.

as.guan: 官人可認得，那是誰家的馬？

asEn.guan: Sir, do you know whose horse that is?
asEn.tong: Child, don't go running after the grooms.

beats.en: Grandpa, why did the horse bolt?

beats.text: 那是上墳回城那家的官馬。
beats.en: It's an official's horse, from the party back from the graves.

beats.text: 騎馬坐轎的，也有慌的時候。
beats.en: Even folk who ride and go by sedan can panic.
Mind your feet. Don't tread on the vegetables.

asEn.guan: Mind your step, sir. Don't tread on the field.
asEn.tong: Child, don't run about in the vegetable field.

beats.en: This vegetable field, they call it a sea of bronze cash.
A sea of bronze? Is there money in it?
Growing vegetables pays ten times what grain does.
A hundred li round the city, not a plot lies idle.
Still cold, isn't it. On the road too?

as.fu: 娘子一個人出城？可當心。

asEn.shi: Off to visit friends outside town, sir?
asEn.seng: Going out of town too, Master?
asEn.fu: Leaving town on your own, madam? Take care.
asEn.li: Brother, off to look for work as well?
asEn.tong: Little one, where are your folks?

beats.en: Have you seen to everything at home?
I have. I still can't stop worrying.
The master's on about home again.
Take care on the road. Come back soon!
They've a long road ahead of them.

as.guan: 官人，他們是出遠門的客商。

asEn.guan: Sir, they're merchants on a long journey.

beats.en: I'll carry this luggage the whole way.
The wind's sharp. Wrap your hood tighter.

beats.text: 人家都回城，他們倒出城。
beats.en: Everyone's coming home, and they're heading out.

beats.text: 又碰見了？聽見後頭的鬧聲麼？
beats.en: You again? Did you hear the commotion back there?
Whoa — easy now, easy.
Is the donkey spooked? Hold the reins tight.
Don't worry, master, I've got it on the rope.
Make way, make way, the sedan's coming through!

as.tong: 小娃兒，莫鑽到轎槓底下！

asEn.guan: After you, sir. The sedan keeps to the side.
asEn.fu: Mind out, madam, the sedan's coming.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't duck under the poles!
asEn.seng: Excuse us, Master. We're back from the graves.
asEn.li: Make room, brother. It's heavy on the shoulder.

beats.text: 轎頂插滿楊柳雜花，上墳回來的。
beats.en: Willow and flowers on the roof: we're back from the graves.
No dawdling. Into town, quickly.

beats.text: 盒裏的門外土，孩兒們等著哩。
beats.en: The children are waiting for the treats in these boxes.
Have you seen a white horse?

asEn.guan: Sir, have you seen a white horse?

beats.en: All was well. How could it bolt!
The grooms have all gone after it.

beats.text: 莫晃，莫驚著轎裏的娘子。
beats.en: Steady, don't frighten the lady inside.

beats.text: 今兒清明，家家都出城上墳。
beats.en: It's Qingming: every family's out of town at the graves.

asEn.guan: Back from the graves too, sir?

beats.text: 這幾日，城外都是上墳的人。
beats.en: These few days the country's full of people at the graves.
Shh, keep quiet about those two pheasants.

beats.text: 開春禁獵，叫人瞧見可不好。
beats.en: Hunting's banned in spring. Bad if anyone sees.
Mind out, these donkeys are carrying charcoal.

as.guan: 官人借過，莫叫炭灰髒了衣裳。
as.fu: 娘子靠邊些，炭灰沾裙子。

asEn.guan: By your leave, sir. Don't let the soot dirty your robes.
asEn.fu: Stand aside, madam. The soot gets on skirts.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't pull the donkey's tail!
asEn.seng: After you, Master. Donkeys are slow.
asEn.li: Brother, give me a hand with this basket.

beats.en: You in front, drive them on to the bridge!

beats.text: 這幾馱炭，是送進城裏酒店的。
beats.en: This charcoal is for the taverns in town.
Sell the charcoal, then buy myself a bowl of wine.
You again? Charcoal isn't cheap, you know.

asEn.guan: Does your house need charcoal, sir?

beats.text: 酒店灶下好幾個爐口，天天燒炭。
beats.en: A tavern stove has several fire-mouths, burning every day.
That donkey's hanging its head again. Worn out.

beats.text: 竹馱子兩邊搭勻，莫偏了。
beats.en: Balance the bamboo panniers, don't let them lean.

beats.text: 客官歇歇腳？店裏還沒客哩。
beats.en: Resting your feet? No guests at the inn yet.

as.guan: 官人歇腳的話，店主在後頭。
as.tong: 小娃兒，一個人跑這麼遠？

asEn.guan: If you'd rest, sir, the keeper's out at the back.
asEn.shi: Off to town for the exams, sir?
asEn.seng: Master, have a bowl of water.
asEn.tong: Kid, come all this way on your own?

beats.en: Still cold. I keep my hands in my sleeves.
Coming, coming. Take a seat.
The threshing floor stays empty till the wheat's ripe.

beats.text: 還在這兒？店裏還是沒客。
beats.en: Still here? Still no guests at the inn.
Take this basket in, then sweep the floor.

beats.text: 那棵老柳截了頂，新枝倒旺。
beats.en: That old willow's been topped, but the new shoots are thriving.

beats.text: 砍下的柳枝紮成捆，好護河堤。
beats.en: The cut branches are bundled to shore up the river banks.

altsEn: Stop! Stop!
The horse has bolted, after it!
Head that horse off!
You in front, cut round that way!
Don't let it charge into the market!
Wait for me…
Can't run any more…
Child, come back, quick!
Don't play by the road, come here!
Quick, get indoors!
Coming, Grandpa!
That horse is so fast!
How will I explain this to the master…
All was well, then it bolted…
No resting, run!
It's heading for the village!
If it gets into the market, someone will be killed.
Heaven help us, let nobody be hurt.
Grandpa, will the horse come back?
I'll hide behind you.
Is the willow on the sedan roof secure?
Mind the willow and flowers don't fall off.
It's in tight.
Steady as you like, not a twig lost.
The graves are swept. Back to town.
Graves visited. Let's get into town.
You at the back, keep in step.
Gently, the lady's inside.
I know, I know.
Hup — steady.

alts: 盒裏的門外土，給孩兒們的。
altsEn: The treats from outside the walls in these boxes are for the children.
Clay dolls, date cakes: not one missing.
The children will be delighted.
We bring these treats home every year.
Hey, isn't that our white horse?
What's that running up ahead?
Send the grooms after it!
Don't panic, the grooms are after it.
We'll be late getting home now.
Fresh earth on the ancestors' graves.
The willow by the grave has grown again.
All year we look forward to these days out.
The flowers out here are at their best.
Have you seen to everything at home?
Is everything settled at the farm?
I have, but I still worry.
It's settled. Don't worry.
The master's on about home again.
Just listen. Don't butt in.
This wind is cold.
Wrap your hood tighter.
Out of town the wind's worse.
There's an inn ahead to rest at.
Whoa — easy, easy.
Steady, slow down.
What's that racket behind us?
Why's the donkey spooked?
Sounds like a horse has bolted.
Don't look back. Keep going.
This luggage gets heavier every step.
Still a long way to go.
Take care on the road!
Come back soon!

alts: 人家都回城，他們倒出城。
altsEn: Everyone's heading home, and they're heading out.
A long journey, in weather like this.
Gee up! On to the bridge.
Bridge ahead. Steady now.
The back's keeping up!
Come on, no dawdling.

alts: 這幾馱炭，送進城裏酒店。
城裏酒店，等著這炭燒灶。
altsEn: This charcoal goes to the taverns in town.
The town's taverns are waiting on it for their stoves.
Sell early, home early.
Sell the charcoal, buy a bowl of wine.
This donkey's hanging its head again.
These two donkeys are worn out.
Rest a bit, then go on.
Don't hurry them. Slowly does it.
Don't let the bamboo panniers slip.
Are the baskets balanced?
Balanced.
I've got a hand on it.
What's that noise outside?
Hey, who's shouting?
Sounds like a horse has bolted.
They're shouting to stop a horse.
Off to town to find some day work.
They say there's work to be had in town.
Between harvests, it's hard on everyone.
Lots of people in town. There's always work.

alts: 這碗熱湯下肚，暖和多了。
altsEn: That hot bowl warms you right up.
Eat your fill, then take the road.
That buffalo's sleeping soundly.
The beasts are resting, so can we.
Who on the road isn't tired?
This row needs weeding.
The weeds are back.
Let's pull them now.
Squat down and pull them slowly.
Not an inch of land out here lies idle.
For a hundred li round the city, it's all gardens.
Vegetables pay better than grain.
These vegetables sell well in town.
Has the ox rested enough?
Hitch the plough, another stretch.
A little longer.
No hurry. The ox is tired too.

alts: 今春的雨水，不知夠不夠。
altsEn: Will there be rain enough this spring?
Hey — a horse has bolted back there!
You up ahead, look out for the horse!
Hoe on my shoulder, off to the field.

alts: 客人還沒來，先把活幹了。
altsEn: This long plank still needs mending.
No guests yet. Get the work done first.
Oof — this basket's heavy.
Into the shed with it.
